profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | C# · TypeScript · Python · SQL | Seattle, WA
profile.summary: I'm a full-stack engineer with 3 years of production experience building ETL pipelines at scale, modernizing legacy systems, and shipping client-facing portals on tight timelines. I specialize in C#, Python, TypeScript, and SQL, and I care about building things that are reliable, scalable, and actually matter to the people using them.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Build reusable front-end components in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for application status portals and search landing pages, reducing redundant development across client deployments.
• Manage client projects end-to-end — from Figma design and stakeholder communication through build and documentation — delivering 100% on time within 1–2 week turnarounds.
• Query Slate CRM using Configurable Joins to retrieve and manage data for 100,000+ students across multiple university admissions workflows.
• Engineer cross-device compatible front-end features and author design walkthroughs to align clients and accelerate adoption.

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected an ETL pipeline to automate daily transfer of 450,000 subscriber records, reducing upload time by 30% via C#, PL/SQL, PGP encryption, and SFTP.
• Spearheaded a PowerBuilder-to-.NET migration, rewriting core business logic in C# across 100+ pages to modernize a legacy claims processing application.
• Built and integrated 20+ internal and external REST APIs using API key authentication, enabling core business operations within the platform. 
• Maintained PL/SQL stored procedures and ad-hoc scripts to manage Oracle database updates, preserving data integrity and access controls for 110 users.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented a dining reservation system in ASP.NET and C# with CSV-based menu upload, maintaining parse time under 1 minute for all file sizes.
• Launched web application on AWS EC2, contributing to a $100K increase in company valuation.
• Prototyped 40 screens in Figma aligned to sponsor requirements, cutting design iteration time by 70%.
• Coordinated weekly sponsor and advisor syncs, adapting to evolving requirements throughout the project lifecycle.

positions.title: Onboarding Intern
positions.description:
• Tested edge cases continuously to identify errors in the model, verifying over 100 documents per hour.
• Annotated data to improve the accuracy of an artificial neural network, handling loads of 1,000+ documents.

projects.title: LegacyWiki
projects.description: A Wikipedia-style encyclopedia for a Sleeper fantasy football league, with a few Sleeper touches (navy masthead, team-colored bands, position pills, a bottom tab bar on phones).

projects.title: Stax
projects.description: Stax is a mobile budgeting application built for Android. It allows you to track income and expenses with ease and provides visualizers to help people understand their overall spending habits.
